a: ZG walks 15-17: the Servant packs at steps 88-97 ended 4 of the 6 raids that reached them, 19-23 dead at the pull; killing a Servant opens its Portal of Madness (24621) on death, and that portal (15141) is where the Voidwalkers come from.
Shadow Shock is an instant 15 yd pulse around it that no kick stops; the Voidwalkers arrive through a Servant's Portal of Madness.

Charges in on aggro (creature_template spell slot 24023, cast by the generic_spell_ai script); it is also Jeklik's summon add, and the Bat and Bat Rider packs cost about 155 deaths over ZG walks 12-17.

ZG walks 12-17: 2 wipes and about 6 near wipes. Unstable Concoction (24024) is the rider's own bomb: below 40 % hp it blows itself up, 10 yd around it, 3 s cast, cannot be kicked; it also shouts Demoralizing Shout on aggro and buffs nearby allies with Battle Command.
Scholomance leg 0-2: the caster packs caused about 95 wipes over 10 runs and stopped 3 runs; both listed casts are kickable. Fear 12542 sits in its template spell slots but is never cast.
Dark Mending is a kickable heal, so the Acolyte dies first; it also mana burns and opens with Shadowform.
Wail of Souls is an instant 30 yd AoE with a knockback and a mana drain, so no kick stops it.
Cone of Cold is a 10 yd frontal cone on a 10 s cooldown; the Adept flees at 15% hp.
Shadow Bolt Volley is a kickable 30 yd AoE; Corpse Explosion comes on a kill and Call of the Grave at 30% hp.
Shadow Barrier shields a friend; the Necrolyte is the pack's other caster.
